reservedKey: Reserved key — buyer contact is taken from their account.
name: Name
isVoucher: This category type is for vouchers
isVoucherHint: Enable if this category type is used for selling vouchers or digital codes.
deactivateTypeDescription: This will hide it from being selectable. You can reactivate it anytime.
activateTypeDescription: This makes it selectable again wherever category types are chosen.
fieldKeyIntro: The columns below are the inputs buyers fill in on the order form — for example User ID, Zone ID, or a phone number. What you define here is what the buyer sees, and what is sent to the supplier when an order comes in.
fieldKeyName: Key is the field's technical name used with the supplier: lowercase, no spaces (e.g. user_id, zone_id, phone). It must be unique within a category, and must not be whatsapp or email — buyer contact is taken from their account.
fieldKeyLabel: Label is the text the buyer sees on the order form (e.g. "User ID"). Leave it blank to use the key as the label.
fieldKeyRequired: Required decides whether the buyer must fill this column in before they can order.
fieldKeyOrder: Column order matters: column #1 becomes the account id and #2 the server, then every column is composed into the one target sent to the supplier. Up to 5 columns.
fieldKeyExample: Examples: Mobile Legends → user_id + zone_id · Pulsa, Data, or e-wallet → phone · PLN (PPOB) → meter_no.
noForms: No forms yet. Click "Add Form" to add one.
label: Label
deleteTypeDescription: This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete this category type.
deleteServerDescription: This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete this category server and its options.
deleteProviderDescription: This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete this category provider and unlink the supplier from this category.
inlineCreateHint: New category — the rest of its details can be filled in later under Category.
categoryCodeHint:
A unique, stable internal identifier. It is used in URLs and integrations, so it is
          deliberately yours to choose rather than guessed from the name.
deleteCategoryDescription: This permanently removes the category and its order-form field definitions. This action cannot be undone.
deleteSubCategoryDescription: This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete this sub category and remove it from the storefront.
noOptions: No options yet. Click "Add Option" to add one.
subCategoryDescriptionPlaceholder: Short summary shown with this sub category on the storefront
providerFormHint:
Point one of our categories at the supplier that fulfils it, and at the supplier's own category
            its SKUs come from. That mapping is what makes those SKUs available to pool.
noProviderCategories: The provider is not publishing any categories right now.
onlyUxiolabs: Only Uxiotopup exposes a catalogue today, so there is nothing to map for this provider yet.
metaTitlePlaceholder: Title for search results & the browser tab
metaKeywordPlaceholder: Separate with commas, e.g. top up ml, diamond ml
categoryLogoCaption: Small logo shown over the card · 3:4 ratio recommended
cardBackgroundCaption: Fills the whole storefront card · portrait 3:4 (e.g. 600×800 px)
checkoutBannerCaption: Wide header on the checkout page · ~16:5 (e.g. 1600×500 px)
tipCategoryType: The kind of catalogue entry (e.g. Mobile Game, PC Game, Voucher). Used to group and filter games on the storefront.
tipRegion: A regional label shown under the game name on the storefront card (e.g. Indonesia, Southeast Asia, Global). Display only — it does not restrict who can buy, and is not the buyer's server/zone choice.
tipCategoryName: The game/category name buyers see, e.g. “Mobile Legends”.
tipCategoryCode: A unique, stable internal identifier (e.g. mlbb). Used in code and URLs; it cannot clash with another category.
tipSubName: Optional secondary label (e.g. the publisher “Moonton”). Shown next to the name and included in search.
tipSlug: The URL-friendly name used in the storefront address (e.g. mobile-legends). Auto-filled from the name; must be unique.
tipDescription: Long-form copy shown on the game's product page on the storefront.
tipMetaTitle: The title shown in search-engine results and the browser tab. Aim for ~60 characters.
tipMetaDescription: The short summary search engines show under the title. Kept under 280 characters.
tipMetaKeyword: Comma-separated keywords for search engines, e.g. top up ml, diamond ml.
tipMetaRobot: Tells search engines whether to index this page and follow its links (e.g. “Index, Follow”).
categoryFormSubtitle: Define a new taxonomy entry games and products can be grouped under.
basicInformationHint: Type, username check, and category identity on the storefront.
categoryFormHint: Input fields shown to buyers when ordering.
mediaDescriptionHint: Category logo and description content for the product page.
seoHint: Meta tags for the category page on search engines.
providerSubtitle: Which upstream supplier fulfils each category, and the integration template used to route its orders.
serverSubtitle: Server and region choices buyers pick from when a game runs its accounts on separate servers.
typeSubtitle: How categories are classified on the storefront, and which of them sell vouchers or digital codes.
subTitle: Sub Category
subSubtitle: Currency and item groupings nested under a parent category, as buyers see them on the storefront.
listSubtitle: Groups games and products so they can be organized and found on the storefront.
